response.sql: SELECT s.entrystat, AVG(se.ambictemp) as avg_ambient_temp, AVG(se.imgcount) as avg_image_count, AVG(se.imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(imgcount) FROM scanenvironment se2 INNER JOIN sites s2 ON se2.zoneref = s2.zoneregistry) as image_avg_minus_overall FROM scanenvironment se INNER JOIN sites s ON se.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.entrystat
